name: SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) Rulebook
description: SEPA Credit Transfer Rulebook governing euro credit transfers across the Single Euro Payments Area. Includes operational and security requirements for participating banks.

license.notes: Public rulebook download; participation requires EPC member-bank status. Some operational specs are members-only. Publicly accessible web resource with no login required (Tier 2 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: open-web no-login content is mirrored in the public dataset repository with attribution).

lifecycle.notes: Active. Annual rulebook revisions; SCT Inst is the real-time companion scheme.
